C++/WinRT, vendored for NovaOS
==============================

Source: https://github.com/microsoft/cppwinrt (MIT, LICENSE), tag
2.0.250303.1 (commit 69c78cfc7920367c4ce9cc024cf8c5b8d217fb1b): cppwinrt/
(the cppwinrt.exe code generator's sources) and strings/ (the base headers
it writes out, base_*.h).  Left out: the Visual Studio projects, the NuGet
packaging, the tests, and prebuild/ (the tool that turns strings/ into
strings.h and strings.cpp; userland/microsoft_ui_xaml/build.py does that
in Python).

winmd/: https://github.com/microsoft/winmd (MIT, winmd/LICENSE), commit
0f1eae3bfa63fa2ba3c2912cbfe72a01db94cc5a: src/, the header-only metadata
reader cppwinrt is built on.

userland/microsoft_ui_xaml/build.py builds the tool for the build machine
(clang++, C++17) and runs it on Windows.winmd and on WinUI 2's metadata
(tools/winrt/winmdwrite.py) to write the C++/WinRT projection WinUI 2
compiles against.  One change, applied at build time (CPPWINRT_PATCHES):
a method whose result parameter row has an empty name (windows-rs's
Windows.winmd has some) gets the default result name, not "void* {};".
